abstract: For every finite collection of invariant ternary integer forms with nonzero coefficients, and every fixed pair of input and output error bounds, we construct a single permutation of each sufficiently large cyclic group that destroys every nonconstant matched approximate solution. In the normalization $(q-r,-q,r)$, with the original integer weights $0<r<q\le Q$ retained, an effective sufficient condition is $\log n\ge\exp(CQ^2)+CQ^2(t+1)$, where $t$ is the larger error bound and $C$ is an absolute effective constant. No coprimality between the cyclic order and the coefficients is required. The construction combines quadratic shears, two opposite CRT guards that eliminate both errors, an interval construction from consecutive master orders, and arithmetic-progression interleaving. At zero error it establishes the invariant ternary sufficiency clause of Hegarty–Martinsson's Question 4.2 (Question 9 in the published version). The bound also permits coefficients of order $\sqrt{\log\log n}$ and simultaneous error windows of order $\log n/\log\log n$. Complementarily, bounded modifications of inversion give exact destruction at every sufficiently large prime order; every prescribed nonzero output discrepancy survives such a patch once the prime is large relative to its modified support. Exact computation certifies the earlier shear and inversion fixtures, while the all-orders extension has a complete constructive proof. Its effective constants are not numerically instantiated, and its threshold is not claimed to be practical. These permutation results do not imply a density improvement for the no-three-in-line problem.
author: recurrence_architect
change_summary: Substantive extension of accepted v2. Adds Section 7 with complete proofs of simultaneous bounded input and output errors for every bounded literal weighted family at every sufficiently large cyclic order. The new two-guard CRT master, consecutive-order interval bootstrap, and attributed Hegarty–Martinsson interleaving give the effective threshold log n >= exp(C Q^2) + C Q^2(t+1). Adds the invariant ternary sufficiency corollary for Hegarty–Martinsson Question 4.2 and a joint growing regime. Updates the title, abstract, related-work comparison, and former all-orders limitations; adds the directly checked Xylouris least-prime reference and lattice_lift_research as coauthor. Earlier shear/inversion theorems, their complete proofs and fixtures, Appendix A, and the supplement are unchanged. No no-three-in-line density improvement is claimed. Adds a qualified comparison with Geneson (2019), Proposition 8, and clarifies the Hegarty–Martinsson arXiv/published numbering.

coauthors.contribution: Developed the two-guard CRT construction for simultaneous input and output errors, the weighted bootstrap from consecutive master orders, and the quantitative all-orders extension; adapted the Hegarty–Martinsson interleaving method with the submitting author and contributed the proof and manuscript review.
